products.name: Altis Air 14
products.short: A 14″ laptop that weighs 1.2 kg and runs for up to 18 hours on one charge.
description: The Air 14 is for people who carry a laptop all day. It’s 1.2 kg, the battery lasts a full working day with room to spare, and the 2.8K screen makes long documents easy on the eyes.
Up to 18 hours of video on one charge, 50% in 30 minutes
Quiet backlit keyboard and a large trackpad
1080p camera with a shutter you slide across
2 × USB-C, HDMI and a headphone jack
Every laptop comes with a 2-year warranty: if it goes wrong, we collect it, fix it and bring it back.

products.name: Altis Pro 14
products.short: The Air’s bigger sibling: a 3K OLED screen, 32 GB of memory and a 1 TB drive.
description: For photo editing, big spreadsheets and a hundred tabs at once. The OLED screen shows true blacks, and the fans stay quiet until you really need them.
32 GB of memory and a 1 TB drive
Up to 15 hours on one charge
3 × USB-C, HDMI, an SD card slot and a headphone jack

specs.Ports: 3 × USB-C, HDMI, SD card, headphone jack

products.name: Corvo Slim 13
products.short: Our lightest laptop under $700: 1.1 kg, a full HD screen and 11 hours of battery.
description: A sensible first laptop for school or the sofa. Light enough for a backpack, quick enough for essays, video calls and streaming.
8 GB of memory and a 256 GB drive
Up to 11 hours on one charge
USB-C, USB-A and a headphone jack

products.name: Corvo Book 15
products.short: A big-screen laptop with a number pad, for spreadsheets and films.
description: The 15.6″ screen and full keyboard with a number pad make it a good desk laptop that still folds into a bag.
16 GB of memory and a 512 GB drive
Up to 12 hours on one charge
Full keyboard with a number pad

products.name: Altis Air 13
products.short: The smallest Air: 1.15 kg, 16 hours of battery, in four colours.
description: Everything we like about the Air 14 in a smaller body. A great laptop for students and anyone who works on the move.
8 GB of memory and a 256 GB drive
Up to 16 hours on one charge
In silver, graphite, sage or sand

products.name: Altis Pro 16
products.short: Our most powerful laptop: a 16″ 3.5K OLED screen, 14 cores and 32 GB of memory.
description: Built for video editing, 3D work and code that takes a while to compile. The big battery still lasts a long working day.
32 GB of memory and a 1 TB drive
Up to 14 hours on one charge

specs.Ports: 3 × USB-C, HDMI, SD card, headphone jack

products.name: Corvo Flip 14, 2-in-1
products.short: A touch-screen laptop that folds back into a tablet, with a pen in the box.
description: Fold the screen all the way back to draw, take notes or watch a film on a plane tray.
16 GB of memory and a 512 GB drive
Up to 13 hours on one charge

products.name: Altis Air 15
products.short: The Air with a big screen: 15.3″, 1.5 kg and 18 hours of battery.
description: Room for two windows side by side without the weight of a big laptop.
16 GB of memory and a 512 GB drive
Up to 18 hours on one charge

products.name: Corvo Play 16
products.short: A gaming laptop with a 165 Hz screen, a 1 TB drive and a keyboard you can light up.
description: Fast enough for this year’s games at high settings, with fans that stay calm and a keyboard made for long sessions.
16 GB of memory and a 1 TB drive
Ethernet, HDMI and five USB ports

specs.Ports: 2 × USB-C, 3 × USB-A, HDMI, Ethernet, headphone jack

products.name: Mira 12
products.short: A 6.1″ phone with a bright OLED screen, two good cameras and a battery that lasts the day.
description: Small enough for one hand, with a screen that’s easy to read in the sun and cameras that cope with low light.
Cases made for it: Dusk sand, Paper planes and Ink wash.

products.name: Mira 12 Pro
products.short: The bigger Mira: a 6.7″ screen, three cameras and up to 27 hours of video.
description: Three cameras, including a 3× zoom, and the biggest battery we sell in a phone this thin.
Cases made for it: Dusk sand, Prism and Ink wash.

products.name: Pell Note 9
products.short: A big-screen phone with a 30-hour battery and wireless charging, for under $450.
description: A 6.6″ screen, two days of battery for most people, and it charges on any wireless pad.
Cases made for it: Paper planes and Prism.

products.name: Pell Nova 5a
products.short: A good phone for less: a 6.4″ screen, 128 GB and a 5,000 mAh battery.
description: Everything most people need from a phone, for the price of a pair of good headphones.
Up to 32 hours of video from a 5,000 mAh battery
Cases made for it: Prism and Ink wash.

products.name: Dusk sand case
products.short: A slim case that fades from white to black sand, with raised edges round the screen and camera.
description: Drop-tested to 3 m on concrete. The print is under a clear coat, so it won’t rub off.
Raised lip round the screen and camera

products.name: Paper planes case
products.short: White paper planes on black, on a slim case drop-tested to 3 m.
description: Our best-selling print. A grippy finish that doesn’t pick up fluff in a pocket.
Raised lip round the screen and camera

products.name: Prism case
products.short: Pink and purple triangles on a slim, flexible case.
description: A flexible case that snaps on in a second and adds almost nothing to the phone’s size.

products.name: Ink wash case
products.short: A white case with a magenta ink wash, slim and flexible.
description: Each one is printed with the same wash, painted by hand once and scanned.

products.name: Kestrel Fold wireless headphones
products.short: Light wireless headphones that fold flat and last 40 hours.
description: Our best seller under $50: comfortable cushions, easy buttons on the ear cup and a cable for when the battery runs out.

products.name: Kestrel Studio wireless headphones
products.short: Noise-cancelling over-ears with a warm sound and 30 hours of battery.
description: Adaptive noise cancelling turns down trains and air conditioning, and a transparency mode lets the world back in at a tap.
30 hours of play with it on

products.name: Kestrel Studio Pro, wired
products.short: Open-back studio headphones with 50 mm drivers and a cable you can replace.
description: For mixing, mastering and long listening at a desk. Velour pads that stay cool for hours.

products.name: Kestrel Buds noise-cancelling earbuds
products.short: Small noise-cancelling earbuds with 28 hours of battery in their case.
description: Three sizes of tips in the box, a case that charges wirelessly, and noise cancelling that works on the bus.
7 hours a charge, 28 with the case

products.name: Kestrel Petal on-ear headphones
products.short: Light wired on-ears in soft mint, with a mic on the cable.
description: Light enough for a whole day of calls, and they fold into a small pouch.
Mic and button on the cable

products.name: Kestrel Sport earphones
products.short: Wireless sport earphones with ear hooks that stay put on a run.
description: Sweat resistant, with hooks that keep them in on the bumpiest trail.

products.name: Pebble mini speaker
products.short: A palm-size speaker that floats, with 12 hours of battery.
description: Waterproof and dustproof, with a strap to hang it in the shower or from a bag.

products.name: Brick portable speaker
products.short: A pocket speaker with a big sound and 10 hours of battery.
description: Pair two for stereo, or take one to the park with a USB-C cable for charging.
Pairs with a second for stereo

products.name: Hollis Dome smart speaker
products.short: A round speaker that plays music, answers questions and runs your smart home by voice.
description: Room-filling sound from a speaker the size of a dinner plate, and a button to turn the microphones off.
Plays in stereo with a second Dome

products.name: Hollis Glow smart bulbs, 2 pack
products.short: Two dimmable smart bulbs with warm filaments, set from your phone or by voice.
description: Warm, dimmable light on a schedule: on slowly in the morning, down for a film, off when you leave.

products.name: Hollis Arc smart desk lamp
products.short: A balanced-arm desk lamp you can dim and schedule, with a USB-C port in its base.
description: Set it to warm in the evening and bright in the morning, and charge your phone from the base.

products.name: Hollis Cube speakers, pair
products.short: A pair of small cube speakers for a desk or a shelf.
description: Plug them into a computer by USB-C or play from your phone over Bluetooth.

products.name: Pixelpine Wave wireless controller
products.short: A comfortable wireless controller with 40 hours of battery, for PC, phones and tablets.
description: Textured grips, quiet buttons and a battery that lasts a long weekend of play.
Works with PC, phones and tablets

products.name: Pixelpine Pro controller
products.short: A pro controller with Hall-effect sticks that won’t drift, and two back buttons.
description: Magnetic sensors in the sticks mean no drift, ever. The back buttons take any input you like.

products.name: Pixelpine arcade stick
products.short: An arcade stick with a ball-top lever and eight full-size buttons.
description: A heavy base that stays put, a lever that clicks like the real thing, and buttons you can swap.

products.name: Pixelpine 87 mechanical keyboard
products.short: A compact mechanical keyboard with hot-swap switches and a backlight.
description: Leaves room for your mouse, connects to three devices, and lets you change switches without soldering.

products.name: Pixelpine Glide wireless mouse
products.short: A quiet wireless mouse that runs for a year on one battery.
description: Silent clicks, a smooth scroll wheel and a small receiver that stores inside it.
About 12 months on one AA battery

products.name: 20 W USB-C charger
products.short: A small fast charger for phones, earbuds and tablets.
description: Charges most phones to half in about 30 minutes. Folds flat? No, but it’s small enough not to block the next socket.

products.name: Braided USB-C cable, 2 m
products.short: A two-metre USB-C cable in a braid that doesn’t tangle or fray.
description: Long enough to reach the bed from the socket, and tough enough for a bag.

products.name: Slim power bank, 10,000 mAh
products.short: A 10,000 mAh power bank as thin as a phone, with fast USB-C charging.
description: Charges a phone twice over and charges itself in three hours.

products.name: Wireless charging stand
products.short: Stands your phone up as it charges, so you can see it on the desk.
description: Charges through most cases up to 5 mm thick, upright or on its side.

products.name: Mira Watch 2, 41 mm
products.short: A smartwatch with a bright screen, heart rate, sleep and 36 hours of battery.
description: Calls and messages on your wrist, workouts tracked on their own, and a screen you can read in the sun.

products.name: Mira Watch Active, 45 mm
products.short: A sports watch with GPS and a week of battery.
description: Maps your runs and rides with GPS and lasts a week between charges.

products.name: Pulse activity band
products.short: Counts steps, sleep and heart rate, and lasts ten days between charges.
description: A light band with a bright screen, notifications from your phone and water resistance for swimming.

altis-air-14: Ordered on Monday and set up by Wednesday. The battery really does last my whole working day.
Lighter than my old one by almost a kilo. The screen is lovely; the speakers are only fine.
Great laptop. I went for 16 GB and haven’t needed more yet.
kestrel-fold: I emailed to ask which pair to get, and they told me the cheaper one suited me better.
Comfortable for hours and the battery never seems to run out.
Folded in my coat pocket every day for a month and still perfect.
paper-planes-case: Fits perfectly and survived a fall onto concrete. I’d love it in more colours.
Grippy without being sticky. The print hasn’t faded at all.
kestrel-studio-wireless: The noise cancelling turns my commute into a quiet room.
Warm sound. A little snug on big ears.
kestrel-buds: Small, comfortable and the case lasts a week of commuting.
Great sound, good noise cancelling for the price.
mira-12: The screen is so bright, and it lasts a full day of heavy use.
pell-nova-5a: Two days of battery and it does everything I need.
Brilliant value. The camera is fine, not amazing.
corvo-slim-13: Perfect for school: light and quick enough.
Good value. I wish it had a backlit keyboard.
hollis-glow: Set them to come on slowly in the morning. Life-changing.
Easy to set up without a hub.
pixelpine-wave: Comfortable for long sessions and the battery goes forever.
Works with my laptop and my tablet without fuss.
pebble-speaker: Lives in the shower now. Surprisingly loud.
Floated in the pool and kept playing.
mira-watch-2: Bright screen and the sleep tracking is spot on.
Battery lasts a day and a half for me.
braided-cable: Long enough to reach my bed. The braid is lovely.
